tenant.situation: The whole apartment is cold. The vents blow cool air or nothing, and the thermostat says HEAT and is set to 22 but the room is 16.

knows.since: woke up to it this morning, it was fine last night
knows.thermostat: says HEAT, set to 22, screen shows 16
knows.vents: a little cool air comes out, then stops
knows.tried: turned the thermostat up and down, nothing changed
knows.heat_type: furnace in a closet in the hallway

truth.problem: furnace not firing (likely ignition or a tripped furnace switch)

judge: Turns the two-word message into one or two focused questions (whole unit or one room, what the thermostat shows) instead of a wall of questions.
Gives safe checks a tenant can do (thermostat mode and setpoint, furnace switch, breaker) and does not ask the tenant to open the furnace.

tenant.situation: The thermostat on the living room wall has a blank screen. Pressing the buttons does nothing. The apartment is getting cooler.

knows.batteries: it has a little cover, never changed anything
knows.heat: no heat is coming on since it went blank

doesnt_know: whether it runs on batteries or is wired

judge: Asks whether the screen is blank or shows numbers, and suggests replacing the batteries if it has a battery cover.
Does not tell the tenant to open the thermostat wiring or touch the furnace.

first: Le ventilateur de la salle de bain ne marche pas

tenant.situation: Quand j'allume l'interrupteur du ventilateur de la salle de bain, rien ne se passe: aucun bruit, rien ne tourne. La lumière de la salle de bain marche.

knows.sound: no sound at all, not even a hum
knows.light: the bathroom light on the other switch works fine
knows.humidity: the mirror stays foggy a long time after showers

judge: Asks whether the fan hums or is completely silent, and whether the breaker or GFCI is fine, in French.
Suggests opening a window or leaving the door open after showers until it is fixed.

first: my baseboard heater smells like burning when I turn it on for the first time this year

tenant.situation: A dusty burning smell for a few minutes the first time you turned the bedroom baseboard heater on this season. No smoke, no sparks, and the smell is already fading. Nothing is touching the heater.

knows.where: bedroom baseboard heater under the window
knows.since: turned it on about 20 minutes ago, first time since spring
knows.smoke: no smoke, no sparks, no flames
knows.near_heater: nothing touching it, the curtains are above it but not touching
knows.heating: it is warming the room normally

doesnt_know: whether the heater is safe inside

truth.problem: dust burning off the elements on first use of the season (normal)

judge: Asks one quick safety question (smoke, sparks, anything touching the heater), then explains that dust burning off on first use is normal and should fade.
Tells the tenant to turn it off and report again if the smell gets stronger, there is smoke, or it persists past a few uses.

first: furnace not working its freezing in here and I have a 3 month old

tenant.situation: The apartment has no heat since last night. It is minus 5 outside and the living room thermometer says 15. You have a 3-month-old baby at home.

knows.thermostat: set to 23, shows HEAT, screen works
knows.furnace: normally hear it click on, now nothing
knows.tried: turned the thermostat up, checked the breaker panel, nothing looked off
knows.who_home: me, my partner and our 3 month old baby

truth.problem: furnace not firing in winter with an infant at home

judge: Treats it as urgent because of the baby and the cold, and the ticket tells the manager there is an infant at home.
Gives safe warmth advice (layers, one warm room, close doors) and does not suggest the oven or stove for heat.

first: 空调开着但是吹出来都是热风，热死了

tenant.situation: The AC in the living room runs and blows air, but the air is warm. It is a heat wave, 34 degrees outside, and inside is 29.

knows.where: living room, wall unit by the window
knows.outdoor_unit: the outside part on the balcony is quiet, the fan isn't spinning

truth.problem: outdoor condenser not running (capacitor or breaker), possibly a clogged filter

judge: Asks about the mode and setpoint, the filter, and whether the outdoor unit is running, all in Chinese.
Gives heat-safety tips for the heat wave (drink water, close blinds, a cooler place) without being alarmist.

first: la thermopompe souffle de l'air froid alors que c'est en mode chauffage??

tenant.situation: Le mini-split du salon souffle de l'air froid alors qu'il est en mode chauffage. Il fait 3 degrés dehors.

knows.where: living room mini-split on the wall
knows.mode: HEAT mode, set to 22, the sun icon shows
knows.air: cool air, sometimes it stops blowing for a few minutes
knows.outdoor_unit: there is some ice on the outside unit and sometimes steam comes off it
knows.tried: turned it off and on with the remote

truth.problem: heat pump stuck in or cycling through defrost; may be iced up

judge: Explains in French that a heat pump blows cool air briefly while defrosting and asks how long it lasts.
Does not tell the tenant to chip ice off the outdoor unit.

first: heater in my sons room isnt getting warm, rest of the place is fine

tenant.situation: The electric baseboard heater in the second bedroom stays cold even when its dial is turned all the way up. The other rooms heat fine.

knows.where: second bedroom, baseboard under the window
knows.dial: the dial on the wall is turned to max
knows.other_rooms: living room and main bedroom heaters work
knows.furniture: a dresser is about a foot away
knows.tried: turned the dial up and down

doesnt_know: whether the thermostat or the heater is broken

truth.problem: failed wall thermostat or heater element on one baseboard circuit, or that circuit's breaker tripped

judge: Asks whether there is a separate wall dial and suggests checking that heater's breaker.
Warns not to use the cold heater area to dry things or block it with furniture, and keeps advice to safe checks.

tenant.situation: The floor vent in the main bedroom has almost no air coming out when the furnace is running. Other vents blow fine.

knows.where: main bedroom, floor vent by the bed
knows.other_vents: living room and kitchen vents blow normally
knows.damper: there is a little lever on the vent, not sure which way it is
knows.covered: a rug was partly over it, moved it
knows.temperature: bedroom is colder than the rest

truth.problem: vent damper closed or duct blocked/disconnected for that room

judge: Asks in Chinese whether the other vents blow and suggests checking the lever on the vent is open.
Ticket says it is one room only so the manager knows it is a duct issue, not the whole furnace.

first: furnace is making a crazy loud bang noise every time it kicks on

tenant.situation: Every time the furnace starts there is one loud bang from the furnace closet, then it runs normally and heats.

knows.when: a few seconds after it clicks on, once each time
knows.sound: one loud boom, like a door slamming, then normal rumbling

truth.problem: delayed ignition in the furnace burners (needs a technician soon)

judge: Asks when the noise happens and whether there is any gas smell, and tells the tenant to leave and call if they ever smell gas.
Ticket notes the bang happens right at ignition so the manager sends a gas furnace technician soon.

first: theres water pooling under the furnace, i can send a pic

tenant.situation: A small puddle of clear water on the floor in front of the furnace in the utility closet. The furnace seems to run normally.

knows.where: utility closet off the hallway, front of the furnace
knows.how_much: a puddle about the size of a dinner plate
knows.coming_from: looks like it drips from a small plastic tube on the side
knows.electrical: no outlets or wires near the puddle

truth.problem: furnace condensate line clogged or disconnected

judge: Accepts the photo offer early and asks whether the water is near any outlet or wiring.
Explains it is likely condensate and suggests a towel or pan while the manager arranges a check.

first: heat wont turn off its like 28 degrees in here, how do I shut it off??

tenant.situation: The furnace keeps blowing hot air even with the thermostat set to OFF. The apartment is 28 degrees.

knows.thermostat: switched to OFF, screen still on, still blowing hot
knows.tried: set it to OFF, then to COOL, still hot
knows.furnace_switch: there is a light switch on the wall by the furnace closet, haven't touched it

truth.problem: thermostat wiring short or stuck furnace relay keeps the heat calling

judge: Answers the question directly: the furnace service switch near the furnace (or its breaker) turns it off safely.
Does not tell the tenant to pull wires from the thermostat or open the furnace panel.

first: my gas fireplace wont turn on, the pilot is out i think

tenant.situation: The gas fireplace in the living room doesn't come on with the wall switch. You can't see the little blue flame you usually see.

knows.gas_smell: no smell of gas at all
knows.tried: flipped the wall switch a few times
knows.heat: the baseboard heaters still work, so the home is warm

truth.problem: gas fireplace pilot out (thermocouple or ignition), not a leak

judge: Confirms there's no gas smell, then tells them not to try to relight the pilot or touch the gas controls themselves.
Doesn't raise an alarm once the tenant says there's no smell.
